definition.text: The wife of Moses (Num. 12:1). It is supposed that Zipporah, Moses’ first wife (Ex. 2:21), was now dead. His marriage of this “woman” descended from Ham gave offence to Aaron and Miriam.

chapters.title: THE SECOND BOOK OF THE TREATISE ON THE ALLEGORIES OF THE SACKED LAWS, AFTER THE WORK OF THE SIX DAYS OF CREATION
